text:
ravi: heads-up: quickstart CI started failing after we tightened package.json exports in @sdk. Both JS and TS samples break.

emily: saw that. Node quickstart using `require('sdk')` gives `Cannot find module 'sdk'`. Edge sample using `import sdk from 'sdk'` hits `does not provide an export named 'default'`.

ravi: apparently the new exports only point to `./dist/edge/index.mjs` and removed legacy fallbacks. We wanted to stop folks importing src files, but broke onboarding.

ana: bot-ci flagged 4 PRs with failing sample jobs. repro steps: clone sample-app, `yarn && node sample/node/index.js` -> fails.

emily: short-term fix: change samples to explicit imports (`import sdk from 'sdk/edge'` or `const sdk = require('sdk/node')`) so docs stay runnable. Long-term: we need conditional exports that cover node.require, node.import, and edge.

ravi: agree. proposed exports snippet: "exports": { ".": { "node": { "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs", "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs" }, "default": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" } }. Also expose `./auth` and `./types` subpaths for TS.

emily: typings are a concern. Our `types` entry points to dist/types/index.d.ts but subpath imports like `sdk/auth` get no types. We should add explicit subpath exports pointing to d.ts files.

bot-ci: CI: sample-app/node failed on job node-cjs. See https://ci.internal/rdw/sdk/exports-failures

ravi: I'll open a rollback PR to restore the previous package.json while we implement a proper conditional exports + subpath typings. Also adding a CI matrix test (node:cjs, node:esm, cloudflare) for any PR touching package.json/exports.

emily: I'll update the samples/docs as a temporary measure and add a note about `sdk/edge` and `sdk/node` subpaths.

ravi: assigning followups: ravi - rollback PR; emily - sample/docs patch; ana - create CI matrix job; we'll also add a publish-time check that verifies both `require()` and `import` resolve.

emily: thanks. will post PR numbers once done. :thumbsup:
